title: Character Sheet Condition Note Freshness
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:character condition_name=* condition_recorded_epoch=* last_verified_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((last_verified_epoch-condition_recorded_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by condition_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures condition-note freshness by condition for character status notes.
value: Lag tracking shows which condition create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside character status notes.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `condition-note freshness` on `rpg:character` events and aggregate them by `condition_name`.
visualization: Table of condition with average and worst condition-note freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long things take for each condition so you can see where character status notes slows down.
